name: Employee Report
query:
SELECT
            e.custom_employee_id               AS `employee_id`,
            e.employee_name                    AS `employee_name`,
            e.designation                      AS `designation`,
            COALESCE(e.employee_number, e.cell_number, '') AS `employee_number`,
            e.company                          AS `company`,
            e.department                       AS `department`,
            IFNULL(manager.employee_name, '')  AS `reporting_head_name`,
            e.company_email                    AS `company_email`,
            e.country                          AS `country`,
            IFNULL(COALESCE(e.region, e.custom_region, e.branch), '') AS `region`,
            IFNULL(CAST(COALESCE(e.login_reminder_count, e.custom_login_reminder_count, le.login_reminder_count, 0) AS CHAR), '0') AS `login_reminder_count`,
            IFNULL(COALESCE(e.hod_name, e.custom_hod_name), '') AS `hod_name`,
            le.course                          AS `course_name`,
            CAST(ROUND(IFNULL(le.progress, 0), 2) AS CHAR) AS `progress`,
            le.completed_on                    AS `completed_on`,
            IFNULL(le.completion_status, 'Pending') AS `completion_status`,
            CAST(le.course_reminder_count AS CHAR) AS `course_reminder_count`,
            COALESCE(le.enrollment_version, 1) AS `enrollment_version`
        FROM `tabEmployee` AS e
        LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` AS manager
            ON manager.name = e.reports_to
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT le1.*
            FROM `tabLMS Enrollment` AS le1
            JOIN (
                SELECT member, MAX(enrollment_version) AS max_ev
                FROM `tabLMS Enrollment`
                GROUP BY member
            ) AS latest
            ON latest.member = le1.member AND latest.max_ev = le1.enrollment_version
        ) AS le
            ON le.member = e.user_id
        LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee Course Documents` AS ed
            ON e.name = ed.employee AND le.course = ed.course
        ORDER BY e.employee_name
